dossier.headline: Hindustan Copper's Q2 profit nearly triples
dossier.summary: Hindustan Copper reported a 179% rise in standalone Q2 FY27 profit to ₹519.54 crore, with revenue up 64% to ₹1,175.24 crore, crediting higher volumes, stronger copper prices and productivity gains. First-half profit rose 172% to ₹872.15 crore.
why_it_matters: Shows how higher copper prices are feeding through to the state-run miner's earnings
questions: How much of the gain came from copper prices versus volumes?
